text.description_html:
Glynn-Johnson 280 Series Sensaguard

The Glynn-Johnson 280 Series is designed to be a self-contained, all-in-one unit, that allows fire doors to be held open and still meet fire codes.

The Glynn-Johnson 280 is a battery powered detector/holder with an ionization chamber that when smoke or particles of combustion are detected will release the door.

The 280 Sensaguard is designed to be used in conjunction with a door closer (not included). Once the holder releases, the door closer should close the door.

Glynn Johnson 280 series is non-handed and can be mounted on the push or pull side of the door.

Features: for Glynn-Johnson Sensaguard

  • Fail Safe Operation - should the battery become low, the unit will release and the door will close
  • Self-contained
  • Adjustable hold open
  • Built-in smoke detector
  • Battery furnished with unit
  • Non-handed
  • UL Listed
  • 1-year warranty
  • Glynn-Johnson Sensaguard Specification Sheet (PDF)
